item.tib: gu ru ri po che mchog thun zung 'brel du bsgrub pa tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gter 'byung
item.coloph: ces glu ru rin po che mchog thun zung 'brel bsgrub (sgrub) pa 'di ni/ 'chi med yab sras rnam gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mchog 7gzi shod g.yung drung spungs rtse'i phyogs mtshams su/ ngo mtshar rang mdog gsal ba'i dus drug bla mtsho las/ lho phyogs glang gdong mtsho nag zhes bya ba ru/ chu sprel zla 9 tshes 1/” nyin par char slong du song ba'i nub mo rmi lam du/ mtsho dkyil khang bzang ngo mtshar can gyi dbus su/ dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs can zhig 'dug pa des dpe chung dril sngon can zhig gtad nas/ 'di ni rig 'dzin chen po phyag rgya ma ral ba yin pas longs shig gsung (gsungs) bzhin bltas tshe/ glu ru rin po che mchog thun sgrub pa yin 'dug bsam pa'i snang ba byung zhing / phyi nyin dge rtags sna tshogs shig dpon slob du mas mthong phul du byung 'phral shog dril du phab na'ang / btang snyoms dbang gis 'phro lus song ba/ slar shing khyi zla tshes la/ dus kyi gru khug gso ba'iu0f38dpal bo hrI chen 'gro 'dul pad+ma gling pa mchog nas 'di mtshon nas les (le'u) phran kha shas 'phro lus song ba kun slar spel bya 'os kyi gsung gsang zab mo spyi bor rtsal ba dang / khyad par gshen bstan dad gus 'byor bas 'degs pa/ u0f38se chen hor gyi gdung sras chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis snga phyi lan mang du rten 'brel legs pa'i mtshams sbyar du ma dang bcas nan bskur (bskul) gnang bar brten nas/ thos chung u0f38smon sras pas rkyang mthing bkra shis rnam rgyal pho brang du spel ba'o//
